about: The ground flora's Blender build (D-332; BLENDER_PLAN row 13; tools/blender/life.mjs flora, tools/blender/life_flora.py). One model per kind of src/world/groundFlora.ts FLORA, the paradise's rose bushes (RoseBeds) and the spring flowers near the walker (smallLife.ts FLOWERS), at the unit size the game scales (the cushion a dome 1 x 0.55 x 1; the others 1 m tall), as the real species: stems and branches as tubes, the foliage as cards whose maps are Cycles renders of modelled sprigs (leaflets, spines, bracts, petals: the atlas, `tiles` x `tiles` of `tile` px), the tragacanth's dome under its bristling tufts. Forms from botanical descriptions and field photographs by recollection (C): Astragalus sect. Rhacophorus / Hymenostegis cushions (grey-green pinnate leaves, rachises hardening into straw spines, pale yellow flowers in the axils, May-June); Alhagi maurorum / persarum (green twiggy stems with rigid yellow-tipped axillary spines, small oblong leaves, pink-red pea flowers on the spines, June-August); Onopordum / Cousinia thistles (winged spiny stems, lobed spiny woolly leaves, globose heads of spiny bracts with purple florets); Rosa x damascena (pinnate leaves of 5-7 serrate leaflets, semi-double pink blooms); Muscari (grape hyacinth), Ranunculus (buttercup), Papaver rhoeas (poppy), Fritillaria imperialis (crown imperial). COLOR_0.r on a vertex is its part: 0 foliage and stems, 1 flowers (the game shows them by season).
